text: Here are the exam favourites. Bell the cat: take on a risky task for the group. A Herculean task: a task needing enormous effort. Achilles' heel: a fatal weakness. Crocodile tears: fake sorrow. A dark horse: someone whose abilities are unknown, but who may surprise. To smell a rat: to suspect something is wrong. A red-letter day: a very important, happy day. To be in the doldrums: to be low in spirits, or inactive.
